 See Tyler Cameron’s Sweet Text About His Daughter to Fiancée Tate: ‘I Feel So Lucky’ 
 Instagram 
 So sweet!
 Bachelor Nation fans got to know and love Tyler Cameron as he searched for love on Season 15 of “The Bachelorette.”
 Since his time on the show, Tyler found love off-screen with his fiancée Tate Madden and the two shared the exciting news over the summer that they are officially engaged. 
 For the past few weeks, Tyler has been competing on “Dancing with the Stars.” And last week during his Dedication Night dance, the couple announced that they are expecting their first baby together and it’s a girl!
 Since then, Tate has been keeping fans updated with her pregnancy online and Tyler has been sharing his excitement over becoming a girl dad. 
 Instagram 
 This week, Tate posted a sweet text message that Tyler sent her about their daughter and expressed, “No dream will ever be better than the reality I am living with you @tylerjcameron 🩷😭”
 The message read, “You’re sleeping so I don’t want to forget to tell you this but I was just sitting here thinking how excited I am for our future. I can’t wait for what life has in store for us.”
 The text goes on to share how excited he is to have a baby girl and see her grow up, learning from Tate. 
 “I’m so excited to be a girl dad and the fact that she’s going to grow up and learn from you. She will have the most incredible example of what an amazing woman is,” he shared.
 Tyler also expressed feeling lucky to go on this journey with Tate and start a family with her. He said, “I wake up every morning more excited that I get to do this all with you. This is going to be the greatest journey of our lives and I’m so lucky I get to do this with you.” 
 The Bachelor Nation star then added how he thinks having a baby girl will affect him. 
 “Having a girl as our first child is exactly what we needed,” he wrote. “It’s going to make me a better man and I’m going to learn so much. She is going to have the greatest example in you.” 
 Who’s cutting onions?! We are so happy for Tyler and Tate on their growing family. We can’t get enough of their sweet relationship and we’re so excited to meet their baby girl next year!
